name: enterprise
label: Enterprise
css: .style-enterprise { background-color: var(--slide-surface, #EDEADE); color: var(--slide-text, #111827); font-family: 'Ubuntu', sans-serif; width: 1080px; height: 1080px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 60px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; } .style-enterprise::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; width: 400px; height: 400px; background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-primary, #072C2C) 0%, transparent 70%); opacity: 0.08; border-radius: 50%; pointer-events: none; } .style-enterprise .hook { font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif; font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--slide-primary, #072C2C); margin: 0; padding-top: 40px; z-index: 1; letter-spacing: -1px; } .style-enterprise .text { font-family: 'Ubuntu', sans-serif; font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); margin: 0; max-width: 90%; z-index: 1; } .style-enterprise .step { position: absolute; top: 60px; right: 60px; font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--slide-primary, #072C2C); opacity: 0.12; line-height: 1; z-index: 0; } .style-enterprise .brand { font-family: 'Ubuntu', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--slide-primary, #072C2C); margin: 0; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 2px; } .slide-code.style-enterprise { background-color: var(--slide-dark-base, #1a1a1a); color: var(--slide-surface, #EDEADE); } .slide-code.style-enterprise .hook { color: var(--slide-secondary, #FF5F03); } .slide-code.style-enterprise .text { color: var(--slide-surface, #EDEADE); } .slide-code.style-enterprise .step { color: var(--slide-secondary, #FF5F03); opacity: 0.15; } .slide-code.style-enterprise .brand { color: var(--slide-secondary, #FF5F03); } .slide-code.style-enterprise::before { background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-secondary, #FF5F03) 0%, transparent 70%); } .slide-insight.style-enterprise { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--slide-primary, #072C2C) 0%, var(--slide-dark-base, #1a1a1a) 100%); color: var(--slide-surface, #EDEADE); } .slide-insight.style-enterprise .hook { color: var(--slide-surface, #EDEADE); } .slide-insight.style-enterprise .text { color: var(--slide-surface, #EDEADE); } .slide-insight.style-enterprise .step { color: var(--slide-surface, #EDEADE); opacity: 0.2; } .slide-insight.style-enterprise .brand { color: var(--slide-surface, #EDEADE); } .slide-insight.style-enterprise::before { background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-surface, #EDEADE) 0%, transparent 70%); opacity: 0.1; } .slide-insight.style-enterprise .insight-text { font-family: 'Ubuntu', sans-serif; font-size: 48px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--slide-surface, #EDEADE); margin: 0; padding: 20px 0; z-index: 1; }
